commitResults.messageTitle: Test: Cover note workflow across storage and profile
commitResults.messageBody: Verify notes survive editing and reloading and appear newest first in the profile. Assert invalid note input leaves both memory and saved data unchanged.
Translate a null element in stored interaction history into a validation error so loading reports DataLoadingException. Cover the model conversion and JSON file path with focused regression tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Test: Cover duplicate notes and failed saves
commitResults.messageBody: Verify identical notes survive command execution, JSON storage, and profile formatting. Show that a failed save leaves the note in memory while the persisted file retains its previous state.

commitResults.messageTitle: Docs: Explain note saving and storage structure
commitResults.messageBody: Clarify note length and reserved tokens, and describe the in-memory state after a failed save without promising disk rollback. Add the interaction-note adapter to the storage UML diagram and regenerate its image.
Keep the command lambda on a Checkstyle-compliant line so the Java 25 clean check coverage build passes.
Prevent unrecognized long options from being silently saved as note text. Cover option placement, blank and long text, and punctuation; align the User Guide with the parser.

commitResults.messageTitle: Test: Verify rejected notes leave data unchanged
commitResults.messageBody: Exercise malformed IDs, duplicate parameters, and unknown options through LogicManager. Check both the model and saved JSON after each rejected command so parser failures cannot silently persist changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parser: Preserve option-like words in note text
commitResults.messageBody:
Limit unknown-option checks to command parameters so notes can retain
ordinary --word text without weakening ID validation. Update the user
guide and parser tests to match the accepted syntax.
